nodeTypes.description: Stores a scalar value and updates it when the Set input is true.

inputPorts.name: In
inputPorts.description: New scalar value to store when Set is true.

inputPorts.name: Set
inputPorts.description: Write enable. When true, copies In into the stored value.

Set.description: Fallback write-enable value when the Set input is not wired.

In.description: Fallback new value when the In input is not wired.

nodeTypes.description: Transmits up to eight data bytes on a selected CAN bus at a configurable maximum rate.

inputPorts.name: D0
inputPorts.description: Payload byte 0. Values are converted to an unsigned 8-bit integer.

inputPorts.name: D1
inputPorts.description: Payload byte 1. Values are converted to an unsigned 8-bit integer.

inputPorts.name: D2
inputPorts.description: Payload byte 2. Values are converted to an unsigned 8-bit integer.

inputPorts.name: D3
inputPorts.description: Payload byte 3. Values are converted to an unsigned 8-bit integer.

inputPorts.name: D4
inputPorts.description: Payload byte 4. Values are converted to an unsigned 8-bit integer.

inputPorts.name: D5
inputPorts.description: Payload byte 5. Values are converted to an unsigned 8-bit integer.

inputPorts.name: D6
inputPorts.description: Payload byte 6. Values are converted to an unsigned 8-bit integer.

inputPorts.name: D7
inputPorts.description: Payload byte 7. Values are converted to an unsigned 8-bit integer.

Bus.description: CAN controller number: 1 selects bus A/FDCAN1 and 2 selects bus B/FDCAN2.

Ext.description: Use an extended 29-bit identifier when greater than 0.5; otherwise use a standard identifier.

Dlc.description: Number of payload bytes to transmit, clamped to the range 0 through 8.

Rate.description: Maximum transmission rate in frames per second. Values at or below zero send every step.

LastMs.description: Internal timestamp of the previous transmission in milliseconds.

D0.description: Fallback value for payload byte 0 when its input port is not wired.

D1.description: Fallback value for payload byte 1 when its input port is not wired.

D2.description: Fallback value for payload byte 2 when its input port is not wired.

D3.description: Fallback value for payload byte 3 when its input port is not wired.

D4.description: Fallback value for payload byte 4 when its input port is not wired.

D5.description: Fallback value for payload byte 5 when its input port is not wired.

D6.description: Fallback value for payload byte 6 when its input port is not wired.

D7.description: Fallback value for payload byte 7 when its input port is not wired.

nodeTypes.description: Reads the latest frame from a configured CAN receive mailbox and exposes its payload. Not an entry point, so the Bus/Id parameters may be wired from other nodes (e.g. a role router); the mailbox read has no in-graph dependencies.

outputPorts.name: Dlc
outputPorts.description: Data length of the latest received frame.

outputPorts.name: Fresh
outputPorts.description: True for one execution step when a new frame has arrived.

Bus.description: CAN controller number: 1 selects bus A/FDCAN1 and 2 selects bus B/FDCAN2.

Id.description: CAN arbitration identifier accepted by the receive mailbox.

LastSeq.description: Internal sequence counter used to detect newly received frames.

nodeTypes.description: Publishes a scalar value to runtime telemetry under a configurable key.

Key.description: Telemetry channel name used when publishing the value.

nodeTypes.description: Maps the instance Role (1 or 2) onto CAN ids: role 1 transmits IdBase and receives IdBase+1; role 2 transmits IdBase+1 and receives IdBase. Role values outside 0.5..1.5 take the role-2 mapping.

inputPorts.name: Role
inputPorts.description: Instance role: 1 = bus node A (sends IdBase), 2 = node B (sends IdBase+1).

outputPorts.name: TxId
outputPorts.description: CAN arbitration id this role transmits.

outputPorts.name: RxId
outputPorts.description: CAN arbitration id this role listens to.

IdBase.description: Arbitration id transmitted by role 1; role 2 transmits IdBase+1.

nodeTypes.description: Sawtooth test byte 0..255 driven by sim time (platform_millis) with period PeriodS seconds; wraps at 255 back to 0.

PeriodS.description: Sawtooth period in seconds (wire-fed from the TxPeriod Var in this graph).
